design_evaluation.summary: A polished dark-first personal tech hub with a clear hero, consistent card grid, working light/dark themes, mobile menu, login modal, and consent-gated AI chat. Main weaknesses are floating widgets (Voice Agent / chat launcher) obscuring card content, no visible close affordance on the chat panel, and some low-contrast links (yellow 'Check →' in both themes).
strengths: Hero hierarchy is strong: badge, two-line headline with accent color, supporting copy, stats row, and two distinct CTAs read in clear order of importance (ui-home-desktop).
Dark and light themes are both fully realized — theme toggle switches the entire page coherently, including the code mockup and AI TEST RESULT widget (ui-theme-toggle).
Card grid uses a consistent pattern: colored icon chip, bold title, muted description, color-coded action link (Explore/Scan/Verify/Check) (ui-home-desktop).
Mobile menu is well-spaced with large touch targets, includes a clear close (×) button, and retains 'Break it' as a visually distinct destructive-style item (ui-mobile-menu).
Login modal uses clear tab structure (Login/Register), labeled fields with placeholders, high-contrast primary CTA, and recovery link (ui-login-modal).
AI chat gate shows responsible-design cues: informational disclaimer, explicit terms-of-use checkbox, and disabled 'Agree & Start Chat' state until consent (ui-chat-opens).
AI TEST RESULT widget uses pass/warning color coding with icons, giving scannable status (ui-home-desktop).
issues: The floating Voice Agent pill and chat launcher overlap the 'Reliability & Fact Check' card, partially covering the description and the yellow 'Check →' link (ui-home-desktop, ui-theme-toggle) — reposition or add safe margin.
The opened chat panel has no visible close button and fully covers the right-hand code mockup; users may be unsure how to dismiss it (ui-chat-opens).
Yellow low-contrast text ('Check →', 'Warning') fails against both dark and light backgrounds; darken in light theme / brighten in dark theme for WCAG AA.

Article count is inconsistent across screenshots (16 vs 12 vs 52) suggesting a live counter without stable formatting — fine functionally, but the tiny muted 'ARTICLES TODAY' caption is hard to read in light theme (ui-theme-toggle).
In light theme, the 'Break it' button and light purple 'Building Trust' accent sit on a near-white gradient with reduced contrast compared to the dark theme.
The vertical 'LIVE' tab on the left edge clips into the hero and overlaps content on narrow viewports; in ui-mobile-menu it still overlaps the menu region.
Mobile menu background shows semi-transparent page content (stats, cards) bleeding through behind the panel, which slightly reduces menu readability (ui-mobile-menu).
No visible focus indicators or aria/state cues are demonstrable in static screenshots; checkbox and tabs in login/chat modals rely on color alone for selection state.

candidate_findings.title: ssrf-loopback-rejected
candidate_findings.expected: Response is 4xx with an error body; no internal page content or 200 response; no stack trace or internal detail leakage.
candidate_findings.actual: The SSRF protection itself is effective: the endpoint refused to fetch http://127.0.0.1/ and returned a controlled JSON error body ({"error": "refused fetch: private/internal IP 127.0.0.1", "title": null, "image": null}) with no internal page content, no stack trace, and no sensitive marker leakage. However, the check FAILS on the stated expectation: the response was HTTP 200 instead of the expected 4xx (400/403/422). Reporting a rejected SSRF attempt as 200 with an in-band error field is a contract/semantic deviation — the security rule is enforced, but the error is not signalled at the HTTP status level, which can mask failures from clients, monitoring, and caches.
reproduction_steps: Compare the sanitized response with the declared semantic contract.
